Metadata.title: Manabi Quiz | Learn together as a family
Metadata.description: Take on quizzes made by parents and kids, and enjoy learning the reasons behind every answer.

HomePage.heroDescription: Take on questions made by parents and kids, and enjoy learning the reasons behind every answer.
HomePage.noMineQuizzes: You haven't added any quizzes yet.

ImportPage.title: Add a quiz
ImportPage.description: Paste a quiz JSON created with AI to save it to your family's quiz library. Required fields and the correct answer are also checked on the server.
ImportPage.promptStepTitle: 1. Ask an AI to create the quiz
ImportPage.promptStepDescription: Photograph the textbook or material pages, then send the photos to an AI chat app (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude) together with the prompt below.
ImportPage.promptStep2: Open an AI chat app and paste the prompt, then attach your photos of the material.
ImportPage.promptStep3: Copy the JSON the AI replies with and paste it into the box below.
ImportPage.signInRequiredTitle: Sign in to add a quiz
ImportPage.signInRequiredDescription: Guests can browse and take quizzes, but only signed-in users can add new ones. Sign in with Google to save quizzes to the library.

ResultsPage.title: Past results
ResultsPage.description: Once you take on a saved quiz, your learning history will show up here.
ResultsPage.signInRequiredTitle: Sign in to see your results
ResultsPage.signInRequiredDescription: Past results are tied to your account. Sign in with Google to view your quiz history.

QuizSession.reviewCompleted: Great job! You've reviewed all your mistakes.
QuizSession.notSavedNotice: You're browsing as a guest, so this result wasn't saved. Sign in with Google to keep your history.

AuthGate.title: Welcome to Manabi Quiz
AuthGate.description: Sign in with Google to add quizzes and save your results. You can also continue without signing in, but you won't be able to add quizzes and your results won't be saved.
AuthGate.guestWarning: Guests can't add quizzes, and results aren't saved.
AuthGate.guestBannerMessage: Browsing as a guest — quizzes can't be added and results won't be saved.
